visualizerParams.title: Code Refactor: Recursive insert Instead of a Loop with Duplicated Branches
visualizerParams.problemDescription: insert walks down with a while(true) loop, and the left and right cases repeat the same null check. Write it recursively. The output must stay the same.

solution.explanation: A tree is naturally recursive: inserting into a tree means inserting into one of its subtrees. The recursive version has one base case and no repeated null checks, and duplicates are ignored in both versions.
